summary_en: FY2027 annual dividend raised to 53 yen per share (regular) plus 5 yen commemorative dividend, totaling 58 yen, from prior guidance of 47 yen. Reflects upward earnings revision and 10th anniversary celebration.
title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Full-Year Business Performance Forecast and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase and 10th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Yokohama Financial Group revised its dividend guidance for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. Annual dividend per share is now projected at 58 yen, comprising 53 yen in regular dividend and 5 yen in commemorative dividend, compared to prior guidance of 47 yen. The year-end dividend is raised to 35 yen (30 yen regular plus 5 yen commemorative) from 24 yen previously announced.

The dividend increase reflects an upward revision of full-year earnings forecast. Ordinary profit is now estimated at 206 billion yen (up from 191.5 billion yen), and net income attributable to parent company shareholders at 145 billion yen (up from 129 billion yen). The revision reflects higher net interest income at subsidiary banks and recognition of negative goodwill gains from the equity method application of SMTB Lease Co., Ltd.

The 5 yen commemorative dividend was introduced to mark the group's 10th anniversary in April 2026. Management expressed gratitude to customers, communities, and shareholders for their support.
